publication.title: City libraries extend their evening hours

payload.text:
The city's libraries will stay open until ten on weekday evenings at six branches, starting next month, officials announced.

The change follows a pilot at two branches where evening visits doubled. Staff said many of the new visitors were students without a quiet place to study at home.

The extra hours are paid for by moving two part-time posts from weekend mornings, which saw the fewest visitors in the pilot.
